articles.title: Study: Obesity 'bigger cancer risk' than previously thought
articles.summary: A new study has found that being significantly overweight could be responsible for more cases of cancer than previously known. Abdominal fat, in particular, increases the risk of cancer — especially among women.

articles.title: Indonesia: Mount Bromo wildfire grows, spurs park closure
articles.summary: Indonesian authorities have closed a popular national park until further notice. Strong winds and rough terrain are making it difficult for firefighters to extinguish the blaze.

articles.title: India: Ex-Education Minister Pradhan says Gen Z 'misled'
articles.summary: Dharmendra Pradhan spoke for the first time since his resignation as education minister following mass protests against him. He said he "suffered" because of Gen Z, who led the protests.
